## Household Disaggregation

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P1-A: MODEL DATA (one calibration run at a time -- see _validation_scripts.load_per_run)
# ==============================================================================
def _load_hhdisag(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    hhdis_df = pd.DataFrame(DBF(outputs_dir / "Joint_HHSize_Income_Worker.dbf", load=True))

    value_vars = [col for col in hhdis_df.columns if col.startswith("S") and col[1].isdigit()]
    id_vars = ["Z", "CO_FIPS"]

    df = hhdis_df.melt(
        id_vars=id_vars, value_vars=value_vars, var_name="Variable", value_name="COUNT"
    )
    df["HHSIZE"] = df["Variable"].str[1].astype(int)
    df["INC"] = (
        df["Variable"]
        .str[3]
        .map({"1": "<$50k", "2": "$50k–$100k", "3": "$100k–$150k", "4": ">$150k"})
    )
    df["WRKS"] = df["Variable"].str[5]
    return df[["Z", "CO_FIPS", "HHSIZE", "INC", "WRKS", "COUNT"]]

df_hhdisag = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_hhdisag)

if debug:
    display(df_hhdisag)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P1-B: OBSERVED DATA (ACS PUMS)
# ==============================================================================
raw_data_path = Path(config_paths["raw_pums"])
final_output_path = Path(config_paths["pums_csv"])

if raw_data_path.exists():
    df_pums = pd.read_csv(raw_data_path, dtype=str)
else:
    url = "https://api.census.gov/data/2023/acs/acs5/pums"
    params = {"get": "SERIALNO,PUMA,SPORDER,ESR,HINCP,NP,WGTP", "for": "state:49"}
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)

    if response.status_code == 200:
        data = response.json()
        df_pums = pd.DataFrame(data[1:], columns=data[0])
        df_pums.to_csv(raw_data_path, index=False)
    else:
        print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
        exit()

numeric_cols = ["PUMA", "SPORDER", "ESR", "HINCP", "NP", "WGTP"]
df_pums[numeric_cols] = df_pums[numeric_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

df_pums["IS_WORKER"] = df_pums["ESR"].isin([1, 2, 4, 5]).astype(int)
workers_per_hh = df_pums.groupby("SERIALNO")["IS_WORKER"].sum().reset_index()
workers_per_hh.rename(columns={"IS_WORKER": "HH_WORKERS"}, inplace=True)

df_hh = df_pums[df_pums["SPORDER"] == 1].copy()
df_hh = pd.merge(df_hh, workers_per_hh, on="SERIALNO", how="left")

df_hh["INC"] = pd.cut(
    df_hh["HINCP"],
    bins=[-np.inf, 50_000, 100_000, 150_000, np.inf],
    labels=["<$50k", "$50k–$100k", "$100k–$150k", ">$150k"],
    right=False
).astype(str)
df_hh["WRKS"] = df_hh["HH_WORKERS"].apply(lambda x: min(x, 3))
df_hh["HHSIZE"] = df_hh["NP"].apply(lambda x: min(x, 6))

observed_df = df_hh.groupby(["PUMA", "HHSIZE", "INC", "WRKS"])["WGTP"].sum().reset_index()
observed_df.rename(columns={"WGTP": "COUNT"}, inplace=True)
observed_df.to_csv(final_output_path, index=False)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P1-C: MERGE MODEL + OBSERVED
# ==============================================================================
# TAZ → PUMA crosswalk via spatial join
puma_url = "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2023/PUMA/tl_2023_49_puma20.zip"
taz_gdf = gpd.read_file(config_paths["taz_shp"])
puma_gdf = gpd.read_file(puma_url).to_crs(taz_gdf.crs)
taz_centroids = taz_gdf.copy()
taz_centroids.geometry = taz_centroids.geometry.centroid

taz_puma_join = gpd.sjoin(taz_centroids, puma_gdf, how="left", predicate="intersects")
taz_crosswalk = taz_puma_join[["TAZID", "PUMACE20"]].copy()
taz_crosswalk.rename(columns={"PUMACE20": "PUMA"}, inplace=True)
taz_crosswalk["PUMA"] = pd.to_numeric(taz_crosswalk["PUMA"])

# fmt: off
# PUMA → County crosswalk
puma_to_county = {
    3000:  3,                                          # Box Elder
    57001: 57, 57002: 57,                              # Weber
    11002: 11, 11003: 11, 11004: 11,                  # Davis
    35014: 35, 35011: 35, 35012: 35, 35013: 35,       # Salt Lake
    35015: 35, 35016: 35, 35008: 35, 35017: 35, 35009: 35,
    49004: 49, 49001: 49, 49002: 49, 49003: 49,       # Utah
}
# fmt: on

df_obs = pd.read_csv(config_paths["pums_csv"])
df_obs["CO_FIPS"] = df_obs["PUMA"].map(puma_to_county)
df_obs = df_obs.dropna(subset=["CO_FIPS"])
df_obs["CO_FIPS"] = df_obs["CO_FIPS"].astype(int)
df_obs = df_obs[["CO_FIPS", "PUMA", "HHSIZE", "INC", "WRKS", "COUNT"]]

df_mod = df_hhdisag.copy()
df_mod = df_mod.merge(taz_crosswalk, how="left", left_on="Z", right_on="TAZID")
df_mod = df_mod.drop(columns={"TAZID"}).dropna(subset=["PUMA"])
df_mod["PUMA"] = df_mod["PUMA"].astype(int)
df_mod = df_mod.groupby(["calib_run", "CO_FIPS", "PUMA", "HHSIZE", "INC", "WRKS"], as_index=False)["COUNT"].sum()
```

```{python}
# Filter to model region using USTMv4 subarea flag (1 = inside model region)
df_hts_p1 = df_hts_hh[df_hts_hh["hSUBAREAID_USTMv4"] == 1].copy()

_inc_detail_map = {
    1: "<$50k", 2: "<$50k", 3: "<$50k", 4: "<$50k",
    5: "$50k–$100k", 6: "$50k–$100k",
    7: "$100k–$150k",
    8: ">$150k", 9: ">$150k", 10: ">$150k",
}
df_hts_p1["income_detailed"] = pd.to_numeric(df_hts_p1["income_detailed"], errors="coerce")
df_hts_p1["INC"] = df_hts_p1["income_detailed"].map(_inc_detail_map)

df_hts_p1["HHSIZE"] = df_hts_p1["hhsize_6cat"].astype(int)
df_hts_p1["WRKS"]   = df_hts_p1["workers_4cat"].astype(int)

df_hts_p1["PUMA"]    = pd.to_numeric(df_hts_p1["home_puma_2022"], errors="coerce")
df_hts_p1["CO_FIPS"] = df_hts_p1["PUMA"].map(puma_to_county)
df_hts_p1 = df_hts_p1.dropna(subset=["CO_FIPS", "PUMA", "INC"])
df_hts_p1["CO_FIPS"] = df_hts_p1["CO_FIPS"].astype(int)
df_hts_p1["PUMA"]    = df_hts_p1["PUMA"].astype(int)

df_hts_agg_p1 = (
    df_hts_p1
    .groupby(["CO_FIPS", "PUMA", "HHSIZE", "INC", "WRKS"])["hh_weight"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"hh_weight": "HTS_Count"})
)
```

### Modeled vs. Observed

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P1-D: COMPARISON + OJS EXPORT
# ==============================================================================
df_mod_clean = df_mod.rename(columns={'COUNT': 'Modeled_Count'})
df_obs_clean = df_obs.rename(columns={'COUNT': 'Observed_Count'})

int_cols = ['CO_FIPS', 'PUMA', 'HHSIZE', 'WRKS']
for col in int_cols:
    df_mod_clean[col] = df_mod_clean[col].astype(int)
    df_obs_clean[col] = df_obs_clean[col].astype(int)

df_mod_clean['INC'] = df_mod_clean['INC'].astype(str)
df_obs_clean['INC'] = df_obs_clean['INC'].astype(str)

df_compare = pd.merge(df_mod_clean, df_obs_clean,
                      on=['CO_FIPS', 'PUMA', 'HHSIZE', 'INC', 'WRKS'], how='outer')

# Exclude Box Elder (limited coverage)
df_compare = df_compare[(df_compare['CO_FIPS'] != 3) & (df_compare['PUMA'] != 3000)].copy()

df_compare['Modeled_Count']  = df_compare['Modeled_Count'].fillna(0)
df_compare['Observed_Count'] = df_compare['Observed_Count'].fillna(0)
df_compare['ErrorPct'] = ((df_compare['Modeled_Count'] - df_compare['Observed_Count'])
                          / (df_compare['Observed_Count'] + 0.001))

# Merge HTS data into comparison table
df_compare = df_compare.merge(
    df_hts_agg_p1[['CO_FIPS', 'PUMA', 'HHSIZE', 'INC', 'WRKS', 'HTS_Count']],
    on=['CO_FIPS', 'PUMA', 'HHSIZE', 'INC', 'WRKS'], how='left'
)
df_compare['HTS_Count']    = df_compare['HTS_Count'].fillna(0)
df_compare['HTS_ErrorPct'] = ((df_compare['Modeled_Count'] - df_compare['HTS_Count'])
                               / (df_compare['HTS_Count'] + 0.001))

ojs_define(hhdis_data=df_compare)
```

```{python}
taz_geo = taz_gdf[["TAZID", "geometry"]].merge(taz_crosswalk, on="TAZID", how="left")
taz_geo["CO_FIPS"] = taz_geo["PUMA"].map(puma_to_county)

taz_geo["PUMA"] = taz_geo["PUMA"].astype(int)
taz_geo["CO_FIPS"] = taz_geo["CO_FIPS"].astype(int)

puma_bounds = taz_geo.dissolve(by="PUMA").reset_index()
county_bounds = taz_geo.dissolve(by="CO_FIPS").reset_index()

def export_geojson(gdf, cols):
    return gdf[cols + ["geometry"]].to_crs("EPSG:4326").__geo_interface__

ojs_define(
    geo_puma_hh   = export_geojson(puma_bounds,   ["PUMA"]),
    geo_county_hh = export_geojson(county_bounds, ["CO_FIPS"])
)
```

```{ojs}
// Filter by selected calibration run + income — HHSIZE (cols) and WRKS
// (rows) are facet dimensions. Filtering to one run is required, not just
// cosmetic: Observed_Count/HTS_Count are repeated on every run's row (see
// the P1-D merge in the Python cell above), so aggregating across more than
// one run here would double/triple-count observed data.
hh_filtered_base = hh_data.filter(d =>
  d.calib_run === hhCalibRunSelect && (vINC === "Total" || d.INC === vINC)
)

// Aggregate by geo × HHSIZE × WRKS
hh_agg_facet = {
  const grouped = d3.groups(hh_filtered_base, d => d[vGeoLevel], d => d.HHSIZE, d => d.WRKS);
  const rows = [];
  for (const [geo_id, bySize] of grouped) {
    for (const [hhsize, byWrks] of bySize) {
      for (const [wrks, records] of byWrks) {
        const mod  = d3.sum(records, d => d.Modeled_Count);
        const pums = d3.sum(records, d => d.Observed_Count);
        const hts  = d3.sum(records, d => d.HTS_Count);
        rows.push({
          geo_id, HHSIZE: hhsize, WRKS: wrks,
          Modeled_Count: mod, Observed_Count: pums, HTS_Count: hts,
          Mod_vs_PUMS:  pums > 0 ? (mod - pums) / pums : 0,
          Mod_vs_HTS:   hts  > 0 ? (mod - hts)  / hts  : 0,
          PUMS_vs_Mod:  mod  > 0 ? (pums - mod)  / mod  : 0,
          HTS_vs_Mod:   mod  > 0 ? (hts  - mod)  / mod  : 0,
          PUMS_vs_HTS:  hts  > 0 ? (pums - hts)  / hts  : 0,
          HTS_vs_PUMS:  pums > 0 ? (hts  - pums) / pums : 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  // Normalise each source by its own grand total across all geo × size × workers
  const totMod  = d3.sum(rows, d => d.Modeled_Count);
  const totPums = d3.sum(rows, d => d.Observed_Count);
  const totHts  = d3.sum(rows, d => d.HTS_Count);
  return rows.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    Modeled_Pct:  totMod  > 0 ? r.Modeled_Count  / totMod  : 0,
    Observed_Pct: totPums > 0 ? r.Observed_Count  / totPums : 0,
    HTS_Pct:      totHts  > 0 ? r.HTS_Count       / totHts  : 0,
  }));
}

hh_xy_cfg = {
  const fm = {
    "PUMS":    { field: "Observed_Count", pctField: "Observed_Pct", label: "Observed (PUMS)", color: "steelblue" },
    "HTS":     { field: "HTS_Count",      pctField: "HTS_Pct",      label: "Observed (HTS)",  color: "#2ca02c"  },
    "Modeled": { field: "Modeled_Count",  pctField: "Modeled_Pct",  label: "Modeled",          color: "orange"  }
  };
  const errMap = {
    "PUMS|Modeled": "Mod_vs_PUMS",  "PUMS|HTS": "HTS_vs_PUMS",
    "HTS|Modeled":  "Mod_vs_HTS",   "HTS|PUMS": "PUMS_vs_HTS",
    "Modeled|PUMS": "PUMS_vs_Mod",  "Modeled|HTS": "HTS_vs_Mod"
  };
  return { xCfg: fm[vXAxis], yCfg: fm[vYAxis], errField: errMap[`${vXAxis}|${vYAxis}`] };
}

hh_vf = vDisplay === "Percentages"
  ? { xf: hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.pctField, yf: hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.pctField,
      fmt: d3.format(".1%"), tickFmt: d3.format(".0%"), axSuffix: " (%)" }
  : { xf: hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.field,    yf: hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.field,
      fmt: d3.format(",.0f"), tickFmt: undefined, axSuffix: "" }

hh_chart_max = d3.max(hh_agg_facet, d => Math.max(d[hh_vf.xf], d[hh_vf.yf])) * 1.05
```

## Scatter Plot

```{ojs}
// 2-D faceted scatter: columns = HH Size, rows = Workers
Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  width: 900,
  height: 140 * hh_wrks_vals.length + 40,
  marginRight: 60,
  marginLeft: 50,
  fx: { label: "HH Size", tickFormat: d => `Size ${d}`, padding: 0.1 },
  fy: { label: "Workers", tickFormat: d => `${d} Worker${d !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`, padding: 0.1 },
  x: {
    label: `${hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}${hh_vf.axSuffix} →`,
    domain: [0, hh_chart_max],
    tickFormat: hh_vf.tickFmt
  },
  y: {
    label: `↑ ${hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.label}${hh_vf.axSuffix}`,
    domain: [0, hh_chart_max],
    tickFormat: hh_vf.tickFmt
  },
  caption: html`<b>${hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.label} vs. ${hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}</b> — columns: HH Size &nbsp;|&nbsp; rows: Workers`,
  marks: [
    // 45-degree equal reference line in every facet panel
    Plot.link(
      hh_hhsize_vals.flatMap(s => hh_wrks_vals.map(w => ({ s, w }))),
      {
        x1: 0, y1: 0,
        x2: hh_chart_max, y2: hh_chart_max,
        fx: "s", fy: "w",
        stroke: "gray", strokeOpacity: 0.7, strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    ),
    Plot.dot(hh_agg_facet, {
      x: hh_vf.xf, y: hh_vf.yf,
      fx: "HHSIZE", fy: "WRKS",
      r: 3.5, fill: hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.color, fillOpacity: 0.6,
      tip: true,
      title: d =>
        `${vGeoLevel}: ${d.geo_id}\nHH Size: ${d.HHSIZE}  Workers: ${d.WRKS}\n` +
        `${hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}: ${hh_vf.fmt(d[hh_vf.xf])}\n` +
        `${hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.label}: ${hh_vf.fmt(d[hh_vf.yf])}`
    }),
    Plot.linearRegressionY(hh_agg_facet, {
      x: hh_vf.xf, y: hh_vf.yf,
      fx: "HHSIZE", fy: "WRKS",
      stroke: hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.color, strokeDasharray: "4 4"
    })
  ]
})
```

## Interactive Map

```{ojs}
{
  if (!document.getElementById("leaflet-css")) {
    const link  = document.createElement("link");
    link.id     = "leaflet-css";
    link.rel    = "stylesheet";
    link.href   = "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }

  const L = await require("leaflet@1.9.4");
  const container = html`<div style="height:560px; width:100%; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;"></div>`;
  yield container;

  const map = L.map(container, {zoomControl: true});

  L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    {
      attribution:
        '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors ' +
        '&copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      subdomains: "abcd",
      maxZoom: 19,
    }
  ).addTo(map);

  // Aggregate map data across all HHSIZE × WRKS combinations for selected income filter
  const mapAgg = d3.rollup(
    hh_filtered_base,
    v => {
      const mod  = d3.sum(v, d => d.Modeled_Count);
      const pums = d3.sum(v, d => d.Observed_Count);
      const hts  = d3.sum(v, d => d.HTS_Count);
      return {
        Modeled_Count: mod, Observed_Count: pums, HTS_Count: hts,
        Mod_vs_PUMS:  pums > 0 ? (mod - pums) / pums : null,
        Mod_vs_HTS:   hts  > 0 ? (mod - hts)  / hts  : null,
        PUMS_vs_Mod:  mod  > 0 ? (pums - mod)  / mod  : null,
        HTS_vs_Mod:   mod  > 0 ? (hts  - mod)  / mod  : null,
        PUMS_vs_HTS:  hts  > 0 ? (pums - hts)  / hts  : null,
        HTS_vs_PUMS:  pums > 0 ? (hts  - pums) / pums : null,
      };
    },
    d => d[vGeoLevel]
  );

  const geo_lookup = {
    "CO_FIPS": { geo: geo_county_hh, prop: "CO_FIPS" },
    "PUMA":    { geo: geo_puma_hh,   prop: "PUMA" }
  };
  const { geo: base_geo, prop: name_prop } = geo_lookup[vGeoLevel];

  const features = base_geo.features.map(f => {
    const key = f.properties[name_prop];
    const row = mapAgg.get(+key) || mapAgg.get(String(key))
      || { Modeled_Count: 0, Observed_Count: 0, HTS_Count: 0,
           Mod_vs_PUMS: null, Mod_vs_HTS: null,
           PUMS_vs_Mod: null, HTS_vs_Mod: null,
           PUMS_vs_HTS: null, HTS_vs_PUMS: null };
    return { ...f, properties: { ...f.properties, ...row } };
  });
  const map_features_hh = { type: "FeatureCollection", features };

  const colorScale = d3.scaleDiverging(d3.interpolateRdBu).domain([0.5, 0, -0.5]);
  function getColor(pct) {
    if (pct === null || pct === undefined) return "#cccccc";
    return colorScale(Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, pct)));
  }

  let geojsonLayer = L.geoJSON(map_features_hh, {
    style: feature => ({
      fillColor:   getColor(feature.properties[hh_xy_cfg.errField]),
      fillOpacity: 0.72,
      color:       "#ffffff",
      weight:      1,
    }),
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const p      = feature.properties;
      const err    = p[hh_xy_cfg.errField];
      const noData = err === null || err === undefined;
      layer.bindPopup(
        `<b>${vGeoLevel} ${p[name_prop]}</b><br>` +
        `<i style="font-size:10px;color:#666">${hh_xy_cfg.yCfg.label} vs. ${hh_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}</i><br>` +
        `Pct Error: ${noData ? "N/A" : (err * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}<br>` +
        `Modeled: ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.Modeled_Count)}<br>` +
        `Observed (PUMS): ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.Observed_Count)}<br>` +
        `Observed (HTS): ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.HTS_Count)}`
      );
      layer.on("mouseover", () => layer.setStyle({fillOpacity: 0.95, weight: 2}));
      layer.on("mouseout",  () => geojsonLayer.resetStyle(layer));
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  if (geojsonLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
    map.fitBounds(geojsonLayer.getBounds(), {padding: [10, 10]});
  }

  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      map.invalidateSize();
      if (geojsonLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
        map.fitBounds(geojsonLayer.getBounds(), {padding: [10, 10]});
      }
    }, 100);
  });
  resizeObserver.observe(container);
  invalidation.then(() => { map.remove(); resizeObserver.disconnect(); });

  const legend = L.control({position: "bottomright"});
  legend.onAdd = () => {
    const stops  = [-0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5];
    const labels = ["≤ −50%", "−25%", "0%", "+25%", "≥ +50%"];
    const swatches = stops.map((v, i) =>
      `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">` +
        `<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0;` +
                     `background:${getColor(v)};border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);"></span>` +
        `<span style="font-size:11px;">${labels[i]}</span>` +
      `</div>`
    ).join("");
    const div = L.DomUtil.create("div");
    div.innerHTML =
      `<div style="background:white;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;` +
                  `box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);line-height:1.5;">` +
        `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;">Percent Error</div>` +
        `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#666;margin-bottom:6px;">` +
          `Red = Underpredict &nbsp;|&nbsp; Blue = Overpredict` +
        `</div>` +
        swatches +
      `</div>`;
    return div;
  };
  legend.addTo(map);
}
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P2-B: PROCESSING MODELED DATA (one calibration run at a time)
# ==============================================================================

def _load_vehown(calib_run, outputs_dir):
    df_mod_vehown = pd.DataFrame(
        DBF(outputs_dir / "VO_HHSize_VehOwn.dbf", load=True, encoding="utf-8")
    )
    df_mod_vehown["Z"] = df_mod_vehown["Z"].astype(int)

    sv_cols   = [col for col in df_mod_vehown.columns if col.startswith("S") and "V" in col]
    df_subset = df_mod_vehown[["Z"] + sv_cols]

    df_melted = df_subset.melt(id_vars="Z", var_name="Category", value_name="Households")

    df_melted["HHSize_Num"] = df_melted["Category"].str.extract(r"S(\d+)")[0].astype(int)
    df_melted["VehOwn_Num"] = df_melted["Category"].str.extract(r"V(\d+)")[0].astype(int)

    df_melted["HHSize"] = np.where(df_melted["HHSize_Num"] >= 4, "4+", df_melted["HHSize_Num"].astype(str))
    df_melted["VehOwn"] = np.where(df_melted["VehOwn_Num"] >= 3, "3+", df_melted["VehOwn_Num"].astype(str))

    df_mod_long = df_melted.groupby(["Z", "HHSize", "VehOwn"])["Households"].sum().reset_index()
    df_mod_long.rename(columns={"Z": "TAZID"}, inplace=True)

    return df_mod_long.merge(df_taz_shp[_geo_cols], on="TAZID", how="left")

df_mod_final = vs.load_per_run(repo_root, _load_vehown)
```

```{python}
acs_var_map = {

    "3_2":  ["B08201_022E"],
    "3_3+": ["B08201_023E", "B08201_024E"],
    "4+_0": ["B08201_026E"],
    "4+_1": ["B08201_027E"],
    "4+_2": ["B08201_028E"],
    "4+_3+":["B08201_029E", "B08201_030E"],
}

df_tract_processed = df_acs_tract[["GEOID"]].copy()
df_tract_processed.rename(columns={"GEOID": "TRACT_GEOID"}, inplace=True)
for new_col, acs_cols in acs_var_map.items():
    df_tract_processed[new_col] = df_acs_tract[acs_cols].clip(lower=0).fillna(0).sum(axis=1)

df_acs_bg["TRACT_GEOID"] = df_acs_bg["GEOID"].str[:11]
tract_hh_sums = (df_acs_bg.groupby("TRACT_GEOID")["Total_HHE"]
                 .sum().reset_index(name="Tract_Total_HH"))
df_bg_weights = df_acs_bg[["GEOID", "TRACT_GEOID", "Total_HHE", "geometry"]].merge(
    tract_hh_sums, on="TRACT_GEOID", how="left")
df_bg_weights["Weight"] = np.where(
    df_bg_weights["Tract_Total_HH"] > 0,
    df_bg_weights["Total_HHE"] / df_bg_weights["Tract_Total_HH"],
    0)

df_bg_disagg = df_bg_weights.merge(df_tract_processed, on="TRACT_GEOID", how="left")

cat_cols = list(acs_var_map.keys())
_missing_tracts = df_bg_disagg[df_bg_disagg[cat_cols[0]].isna()]["TRACT_GEOID"].unique()
if len(_missing_tracts) > 0:
    print(f"WARNING: {len(_missing_tracts)} Tracts unmatched — affected BGs will have zero disaggregated counts.")
df_bg_disagg[cat_cols] = df_bg_disagg[cat_cols].fillna(0)

df_bg_disagg[cat_cols] = df_bg_disagg[cat_cols].mul(df_bg_disagg["Weight"], axis=0)

df_acs_long = (
    df_bg_disagg
    .melt(id_vars=["GEOID", "geometry"], value_vars=cat_cols,
          var_name="Category", value_name="Households")
    .assign(
        HHSize=lambda df: df["Category"].str.split("_").str[0],
        VehOwn=lambda df: df["Category"].str.split("_").str[1],
    )
    .drop(columns=["Category"])
)

df_acs_final = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df_acs_long, geometry="geometry", crs=PROJECT_CRS)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# P2-E: AGGREGATION AND VALIDATION METRICS
# ==============================================================================

def summarize_validation(geo_cols):
    group_cols = geo_cols + ["HHSize", "VehOwn"]
    # df_mod_tagged carries multiple calibration runs' rows (see P2-B/P2-D) --
    # keep calib_run in its own groupby so runs don't get summed together;
    # ACS/HTS aren't run-specific, so calib_run just rides along on the
    # mod_agg side of the merge below (repeated across each run, correctly).
    mod_agg = (df_mod_tagged.groupby(group_cols + ["calib_run"])["Households"]
               .sum().reset_index().rename(columns={"Households": "Model_HH"}))
    acs_agg = (df_acs_tagged.groupby(group_cols)["Households"]
               .sum().reset_index().rename(columns={"Households": "ACS_HH"}))
    hts_agg = (df_hts_tagged.groupby(group_cols)["hh_weight"]
               .sum().reset_index().rename(columns={"hh_weight": "HTS_HH"}))

    df_merged = pd.merge(mod_agg, acs_agg, on=group_cols, how="outer")
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, hts_agg, on=group_cols, how="outer")
    df_merged = df_merged.fillna({"Model_HH": 0, "ACS_HH": 0, "HTS_HH": 0})

    df_merged["Diff"]         = df_merged["Model_HH"] - df_merged["ACS_HH"]
    df_merged["Pct_Diff"]     = np.where(
        df_merged["ACS_HH"] > 0, df_merged["Diff"] / df_merged["ACS_HH"], 0)
    df_merged["Diff_HTS"]     = df_merged["Model_HH"] - df_merged["HTS_HH"]
    df_merged["Pct_Diff_HTS"] = np.where(
        df_merged["HTS_HH"] > 0, df_merged["Diff_HTS"] / df_merged["HTS_HH"], 0)
    return df_merged

df_val_county = summarize_validation(["County"])
df_val_super  = summarize_validation(["DISTSUPER", "DSUP_NAME"])
df_val_large  = summarize_validation(["DISTLRG",   "DLRG_NAME"])
df_val_dmed   = summarize_validation(["DISTMED",   "DMED_NAME"])
df_val_small  = summarize_validation(["DISTSML",   "DSML_NAME"])
df_val_city   = summarize_validation(["City"])
```

```{ojs}
// Filter by selected calibration run + geography (HHSize/VehOwn are facet
// dimensions). Filtering to one run avoids double-counting ACS_HH/HTS_HH,
// which are repeated on every run's row -- same reasoning as hh_filtered_base above.
vo_filtered_base = transpose(val_data_ojs).filter(row =>
  row.GeoLevel === geo_level && row.calib_run === voCalibRunSelect
)

// Aggregate by GeoName × HHSize × VehOwn
vo_agg_facet = {
  const grouped = d3.groups(vo_filtered_base, d => d.GeoName, d => d.HHSize, d => d.VehOwn);
  const rows = [];
  for (const [GeoName, bySize] of grouped) {
    for (const [hhsize, byVeh] of bySize) {
      for (const [vehown, records] of byVeh) {
        const mod = d3.sum(records, d => d.Model_HH);
        const acs = d3.sum(records, d => d.ACS_HH);
        const hts = d3.sum(records, d => d.HTS_HH);
        rows.push({
          GeoName, HHSize: hhsize, VehOwn: vehown,
          Model_HH: mod, ACS_HH: acs, HTS_HH: hts,
          Pct_Error:      acs > 0 ? (mod - acs) / acs : 0,
          Pct_Error_HTS:  hts > 0 ? (mod - hts) / hts : 0,
          Pct_ACS_vs_Mod: mod > 0 ? (acs - mod) / mod : 0,
          Pct_HTS_vs_Mod: mod > 0 ? (hts - mod) / mod : 0,
          Pct_ACS_vs_HTS: hts > 0 ? (acs - hts) / hts : 0,
          Pct_HTS_vs_ACS: acs > 0 ? (hts - acs) / acs : 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  // Normalise each source by its own grand total
  const totMod = d3.sum(rows, d => d.Model_HH);
  const totAcs = d3.sum(rows, d => d.ACS_HH);
  const totHts = d3.sum(rows, d => d.HTS_HH);
  return rows.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    Model_Pct:  totMod > 0 ? r.Model_HH / totMod : 0,
    ACS_Pct:    totAcs > 0 ? r.ACS_HH   / totAcs : 0,
    HTS_Pct_vo: totHts > 0 ? r.HTS_HH   / totHts : 0,
  }));
}

vo_xy_cfg = {
  const fm = {
    "ACS":     { field: "ACS_HH",   pctField: "ACS_Pct",    label: "Observed (ACS)", color: "steelblue" },
    "HTS":     { field: "HTS_HH",   pctField: "HTS_Pct_vo", label: "Observed (HTS)", color: "#2ca02c"   },
    "Modeled": { field: "Model_HH", pctField: "Model_Pct",  label: "Modeled",        color: "orange"    }
  };
  const errMap = {
    "ACS|Modeled": "Pct_Error",       "ACS|HTS":     "Pct_HTS_vs_ACS",
    "HTS|Modeled": "Pct_Error_HTS",   "HTS|ACS":     "Pct_ACS_vs_HTS",
    "Modeled|ACS": "Pct_ACS_vs_Mod",  "Modeled|HTS": "Pct_HTS_vs_Mod"
  };
  return { xCfg: fm[vo_x_axis], yCfg: fm[vo_y_axis], errField: errMap[`${vo_x_axis}|${vo_y_axis}`] };
}

vo_vf = vo_display === "Percentages"
  ? { xf: vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.pctField, yf: vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.pctField,
      fmt: d3.format(".1%"), tickFmt: d3.format(".0%"), axSuffix: " (%)" }
  : { xf: vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.field,    yf: vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.field,
      fmt: d3.format(",.0f"), tickFmt: undefined, axSuffix: "" }

vo_max_val = d3.max(vo_agg_facet, d => Math.max(d[vo_vf.xf], d[vo_vf.yf])) * 1.05
```

```{ojs}
// 2-D faceted scatter: columns = HH Size, rows = Vehicle Ownership
Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  width: 900,
  height: 140 * vo_vehown_vals.length + 40,
  marginRight: 60,
  marginLeft: 50,
  fx: { label: "HH Size",  tickFormat: d => `Size ${d}`, padding: 0.1 },
  fy: { label: "Vehicles", tickFormat: d => `${d} Veh`,  padding: 0.1 },
  x: {
    label: `${vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}${vo_vf.axSuffix} →`,
    domain: [0, vo_max_val],
    tickFormat: vo_vf.tickFmt
  },
  y: {
    label: `↑ ${vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.label}${vo_vf.axSuffix}`,
    domain: [0, vo_max_val],
    tickFormat: vo_vf.tickFmt
  },
  caption: html`<b>${vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.label} vs. ${vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}</b> — columns: HH Size &nbsp;|&nbsp; rows: Vehicle Ownership`,
  marks: [
    // 45-degree equal reference line in every facet panel
    Plot.link(
      vo_hhsize_vals.flatMap(s => vo_vehown_vals.map(v => ({ s, v }))),
      {
        x1: 0, y1: 0,
        x2: vo_max_val, y2: vo_max_val,
        fx: "s", fy: "v",
        stroke: "gray", strokeOpacity: 0.7, strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    ),
    Plot.dot(vo_agg_facet, {
      x: vo_vf.xf, y: vo_vf.yf,
      fx: "HHSize", fy: "VehOwn",
      r: 3.5, fill: vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.color, fillOpacity: 0.6,
      tip: true,
      title: d =>
        `${d.GeoName}\nHH Size: ${d.HHSize}  Vehicles: ${d.VehOwn}\n` +
        `${vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}: ${vo_vf.fmt(d[vo_vf.xf])}\n` +
        `${vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.label}: ${vo_vf.fmt(d[vo_vf.yf])}`
    }),
    Plot.linearRegressionY(vo_agg_facet, {
      x: vo_vf.xf, y: vo_vf.yf,
      fx: "HHSize", fy: "VehOwn",
      stroke: vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.color, strokeDasharray: "4 4"
    })
  ]
})
```

## Interactive Map

```{ojs}
{
  if (!document.getElementById("leaflet-css-vo")) {
    const link  = document.createElement("link");
    link.id     = "leaflet-css-vo";
    link.rel    = "stylesheet";
    link.href   = "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }

  const L = await require("leaflet@1.9.4");

  const container = html`<div style="height:560px; width:100%; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;"></div>`;
  yield container;

  const map = L.map(container, {zoomControl: true});

  L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    {
      attribution:
        '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors ' +
        '&copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      subdomains: "abcd",
      maxZoom: 19,
    }
  ).addTo(map);

  // Aggregate map data across all HHSize × VehOwn combinations for selected geography
  const mapAgg = d3.rollup(
    vo_filtered_base,
    v => {
      const mod = d3.sum(v, d => d.Model_HH);
      const acs = d3.sum(v, d => d.ACS_HH);
      const hts = d3.sum(v, d => d.HTS_HH);
      return {
        Model_HH: mod, ACS_HH: acs, HTS_HH: hts,
        Pct_Error:      acs > 0 ? (mod - acs) / acs : null,
        Pct_Error_HTS:  hts > 0 ? (mod - hts) / hts : null,
        Pct_ACS_vs_Mod: mod > 0 ? (acs - mod) / mod : null,
        Pct_HTS_vs_Mod: mod > 0 ? (hts - mod) / mod : null,
        Pct_ACS_vs_HTS: hts > 0 ? (acs - hts) / hts : null,
        Pct_HTS_vs_ACS: acs > 0 ? (hts - acs) / acs : null,
      };
    },
    d => d.GeoName
  );

  const geo_lookup = {
    "County":          {geo: geo_counties, prop: "County"},
    "Super District":  {geo: geo_super,    prop: "DSUP_NAME"},
    "Large District":  {geo: geo_large,    prop: "DLRG_NAME"},
    "Medium District": {geo: geo_medium,   prop: "DMED_NAME"},
    "Small District":  {geo: geo_small,    prop: "DSML_NAME"},
    "City":            {geo: geo_cities,   prop: "City"},
  };
  const {geo: base_geo, prop: name_prop} = geo_lookup[geo_level];

  const features = base_geo.features.map(f => {
    const prop_name = f.properties[name_prop];
    const row = mapAgg.get(prop_name)
      || { Model_HH: 0, ACS_HH: 0, HTS_HH: 0,
           Pct_Error: null, Pct_Error_HTS: null,
           Pct_ACS_vs_Mod: null, Pct_HTS_vs_Mod: null,
           Pct_ACS_vs_HTS: null, Pct_HTS_vs_ACS: null };
    return { ...f, properties: { ...f.properties, GeoName: prop_name, ...row } };
  });
  const map_features_vo = { type: "FeatureCollection", features };

  const colorScale = d3.scaleDiverging(d3.interpolateRdBu).domain([0.5, 0, -0.5]);
  function getColor(pct) {
    if (pct === null || pct === undefined) return "#cccccc";
    return colorScale(Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, pct)));
  }

  let geojsonLayer = L.geoJSON(map_features_vo, {
    style: feature => ({
      fillColor:   getColor(feature.properties[vo_xy_cfg.errField]),
      fillOpacity: 0.72,
      color:       "#ffffff",
      weight:      1,
    }),
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const p      = feature.properties;
      const err    = p[vo_xy_cfg.errField];
      const noData = err === null || err === undefined;
      layer.bindPopup(
        `<b>${p.GeoName}</b><br>` +
        `<i style="font-size:10px;color:#666">${vo_xy_cfg.yCfg.label} vs. ${vo_xy_cfg.xCfg.label}</i><br>` +
        `Pct Error: ${noData ? "N/A" : (err * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}<br>` +
        `Modeled: ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.Model_HH)}<br>` +
        `Observed (ACS): ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.ACS_HH)}<br>` +
        `Observed (HTS): ${d3.format(",.0f")(p.HTS_HH)}`
      );
      layer.on("mouseover", () => layer.setStyle({fillOpacity: 0.95, weight: 2}));
      layer.on("mouseout",  () => geojsonLayer.resetStyle(layer));
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  if (geojsonLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
    map.fitBounds(geojsonLayer.getBounds(), {padding: [10, 10]});
  }

  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      map.invalidateSize();
      if (geojsonLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
        map.fitBounds(geojsonLayer.getBounds(), {padding: [10, 10]});
      }
    }, 100);
  });
  resizeObserver.observe(container);
  invalidation.then(() => { map.remove(); resizeObserver.disconnect(); });

  const legend = L.control({position: "bottomright"});
  legend.onAdd = () => {
    const stops  = [-0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5];
    const labels = ["≤ −50%", "−25%", "0%", "+25%", "≥ +50%"];
    const swatches = stops.map((v, i) =>
      `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">` +
        `<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0;` +
                     `background:${getColor(v)};border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);"></span>` +
        `<span style="font-size:11px;">${labels[i]}</span>` +
      `</div>`
    ).join("");
    const div = L.DomUtil.create("div");
    div.innerHTML =
      `<div style="background:white;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;` +
                  `box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);line-height:1.5;">` +
        `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;">Percent Error</div>` +
        `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#666;margin-bottom:6px;">` +
          `Red = Underpredict &nbsp;|&nbsp; Blue = Overpredict` +
        `</div>` +
        swatches +
      `</div>`;
    return div;
  };
  legend.addTo(map);
}
```

## Data Table

```{ojs}
vo_cnt_fmt = vo_display === "Percentages" ? d3.format(".1%") : d3.format(",.0f")

viewof summary_table = Inputs.table(vo_agg_facet, {
  columns: [
    "GeoName", "HHSize", "VehOwn",
    vo_display === "Percentages" ? "Model_Pct"  : "Model_HH",
    vo_display === "Percentages" ? "ACS_Pct"    : "ACS_HH",
    vo_display === "Percentages" ? "HTS_Pct_vo" : "HTS_HH",
    "Pct_Error", "Pct_Error_HTS", "Pct_ACS_vs_HTS"
  ],
  header: {
    GeoName:        "Geography",
    HHSize:         "HH Size",
    VehOwn:         "Vehicles",
    Model_HH:       "Modeled",    Model_Pct:  "Modeled (%)",
    ACS_HH:         "ACS",        ACS_Pct:    "ACS (%)",
    HTS_HH:         "HTS",        HTS_Pct_vo: "HTS (%)",
    Pct_Error:      "Mod vs ACS",
    Pct_Error_HTS:  "Mod vs HTS",
    Pct_ACS_vs_HTS: "ACS vs HTS"
  },
  format: {
    Model_HH:       vo_cnt_fmt, Model_Pct:  vo_cnt_fmt,
    ACS_HH:         vo_cnt_fmt, ACS_Pct:    vo_cnt_fmt,
    HTS_HH:         vo_cnt_fmt, HTS_Pct_vo: vo_cnt_fmt,
    Pct_Error:      d3.format("+.1%"),
    Pct_Error_HTS:  d3.format("+.1%"),
    Pct_ACS_vs_HTS: d3.format("+.1%")
  },
  sort:    "Pct_Error",
  reverse: true,
  rows:    15,
  width:   "100%"
})
```
